definition: A billionaire whose wealth and political power materially reinforce one another through preferential access, policy influence, state patronage, or a documented exchange securing private economic advantage.
method: Case-based editorial assessment, not a numerical corruption score. Historical and disputed evidence is labeled. Wealth, nationality, inheritance, office, monopoly, donations, contracts or sanctions alone do not determine a verdict.
limitations: Initial research, AI-assisted and not independently editorially reviewed. Coverage is uneven and mostly unassessed. Historical evidence does not establish ongoing 2026 conduct. Narrow source checks must not be treated as exoneration.
